name: Copenhagen
about: Summer brings long light-filled days, winter is dark and cold but cozy and much less crowded.
overview: Colorful harbor-front townhouses, world-class New Nordic dining, and one of the world's most bike-friendly capitals.
costOverview: Nordic prices apply across the board — even a casual open-faced sandwich or a coffee costs noticeably more than in the rest of Europe.
